description: Angular component for configuring data keys in a widget, including form handling, validation, and dynamic key fetching.

classes.name: DataKeyConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring data keys within a widget, handling form logic, validation, and dynamic data fetching.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, subscriptions, and fetches widget info.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component (not implemented).

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given DataKey value.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators based on current model state.

methods.name: updateComparisonValues
methods.description: Updates comparison-related form fields based on current values.

methods.name: updateComparisonValidators
methods.description: Enables/disables comparison validators based on aggregation and comparison settings.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal DataKey model from form values and propagates changes.

methods.name: clearKey
methods.description: Clears the key input field and refocuses it.

methods.name: fetchKeys
methods.description: Fetches matching key names based on search text.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves available keys from callbacks or predefined lists.

methods.description: Creates a filter function for key search.

methods.name: validateOnSubmit
methods.description: Validates the component on form submission, including function body validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the form and settings, returning validation errors if any.
